mathematics: The nonsplit transport bijection restricts from Aut(S) to the given subgroup B when its transports are chosen in B.
H0 is determined by the fixed outer character, normal in H, with index at most b0. Its cover and the fixed field character both come from subgroups of the finite tame outer quotient.
Ambient PGL conjugacy identifies at most |PGL| actual S-conjugacy classes of B0-valued restrictions; no ambient normalizer hypothesis is used.

Choosing an actual B0-valued representative and normalizing by S preserves full B-valuedness and the outer character. Each of the a-1 coset images lies in a prescribed S-coset, giving precisely the |S|^(a-1) upper bound without embedding B in the ambient group.
The inequality q^((A_R*a*t+1)*r^2)*|S|^(a-1) <= |S^t|^(kappa*(A_R*b0+1)+b0-1) and the stated ceiling/crown generator bound check.
The bounded normal-subgroup index, size comparison and radial-tame outer quotient remain explicit; this is a closure of the restricted crown result, not full finite generation.
